function.name: search_places
function.description: Search for shops and places near the user's current location. Supports queries like "ramen nearby" or "cafe".

query.description: Search query (e.g. ramen, cafe, convenience store)

function.name: get_place_details
function.description: Get reviews and an AI summary for a place obtained via search_places. Get place_id from the search_places results.

place_id.description: Place ID obtained from search_places results

function.name: get_directions
function.description: Give the distance, travel time, and route from the user's current location to a destination. Get place_id from the search_places results.

mode.description: Travel mode: walking, driving, or transit. Default is walking.
